title: Onboard quadrocopter failsafe: flight after actuator failure
summary: ETH Zurich researchers demonstrate a quadrocopter that keeps flying stably after losing a motor and propeller entirely, with the algorithm running onboard while a pilot flies it.
why: It is the standard citation in drone and eVTOL threads for the claim that multirotors can survive a failed rotor with the right control algorithm.

quote.text: controlled, safe landings of quadrotors with a single failed motor have been demonstrated, see this ETH Zurich video from 2014
